maya: kicking off a quick cross-svc cutover check. planned quiet window in 30m. api/runtime/console/router please ack.
jon: ack from runtime. we'll warm KV caches and hold autoscale down until after canary. timeline ok.
liam: console ack. I'll freeze UI deploys and disable schema migrations during the window.
kate: api ack. pinning v2.3.1->v2.4.0 for the change, will add header flag: X-Feature: new-route
ravi: router ack. prepping header-swap rule and shadow routing for 10% initially. will keep health-probes at 2s.
maya: deploybot schedule request sent. canary = 1% traffic -> 10% after 5m -> 100% after 20m if healthy.
deploybot: Deploy plan created: deploy[api:v2.4.0, runtime:v12-kernel, console:static-2026-03-23, router:hdr-swap]. Canary steps automated. See /deploy/7070707070
jon: note — runtime kernel change introduces new batching; latency spikes possible for first 2 minutes. telemetry alerting on p99.
liam: adding a short release note in console: "Routing header change — expect transient 503s <1%". tagging SRE.
maya: rollback criteria (agree?): 1) p99 latency > 2x baseline for 3m; 2) errors > 1% sustained for 2m; 3) canary healthchecks failing.
kate: agree. add fatal check: schema mismatch errors in API responses > 0.5% for 2m -> immediate roll.
ravi: router will hold at 10% if any 5xx spike. manual override available: /ops/router/hold
ops-bot: Reminder: quiet window enforced from 2026-03-23T03:30Z -> 2026-03-23T04:30Z. Pager roster: jon, anjali, liam.
maya: final preflight: everyone confirm their fallback variant is ready (api->v2.3.1, runtime->compat-11). If yes, post :thumbsup:
jon: :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
kate: :thumbsup:
ravi: :thumbsup:
